what: MEASURE BREAKOUT'S PROPRIETARY TERMINAL (checklist PROP-TERM). The breakout_terminal adapter (PR #13658, stacked on PROP-EXEC #13647) is built to UNMEASURED DOM against synthetic fixtures. Nothing past curl's Cloudflare 403 is measured: run 36337076971 (issue #13279) showed the VM's headless Chromium gets a page at app.breakoutprop.com that is neither a challenge nor the DXtrade form, shape not captured. The sandbox cannot measure it (proxy CA not trusted by Chromium there; installing NSS tools was refused by the session's permission layer). Known risks: BREAKOUT_DX_* are the DXtrade login (config/prop_platforms.yaml header), so the dashboard may reject them; spec S27 suggests an emailed code at sign-in, which would make the adapter infeasible; no proprietary-terminal account exists until the re-buy, so the terminal DOM, ticket kind and venue symbol names (breakout_terminal_symbol rows) stay unmeasured until then.
